verses.en: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verses.sm: O fua faatáutau faaaimago e inosia ia e le ALII; a o le taa e fua a“ e atoatoa, o lona lea fiafia.

verses.en: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.sm: A sau le faamaualuga, ona sau ai lea o le mā; a o i ai le poto i e faamaulalo.

verses.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.sm: O le amio sao a e ua amiotonu e taʻitaʻiina ai i latou; ao le faapiopio o e amioletonu e fano ai i latou.

verses.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.sm: E le aoga le oloa i le aso o le toasa; a o le amiotonu, e laveai lea nai le oti.

verses.en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.sm: O le amiotonu a le ua sao e faalauleleiina ai lona ala; a o lana amio leaga,-e paú ai le ua amio leaga.

verses.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.sm: O le amiotonu a e amio sa‘o e laveaiina ai i latou; a o e faapiopio, e maua i latou i a latou amio paaa.

verses.en: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
verses.sm: A oti le tagata amio leaga, ua fano lona faatuatuaga; e fano foi le faamoemoe o le tagata amioletonu.

verses.en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.sm: E laveaiina lē amiotonu ai le puapuaga; a e sau lē amio leaga e sui a“ o ia.

verses.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.sm: O le gutu o le faalematau e fano ai lé la te tuaoi; a o le poto e laveaiina a‘i E amiotonu.

verses.en: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.sm: Ua olioli le aai pe a manuia e amiotonu; e ofo fiafia foi pe a fano E amio leaga.

verses.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.sm: O le faamanuia o e amio sao e faamamaluina ai le aai; a o gutu o E amio leaga, e lepetia ai.

verses.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.sm: O le ua leai sona mafaufau na te ʻinoʻino i lē la te tuaoi; a ua faalologo le tagata mafaufau.

verses.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.sm: O lé fealuai ma feaveaveai, na te faaali upu faalilo; a o le ua loto faamaoni na te tanutanumai le upu.

verses.en: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.sm: A leai sé pule, ua rnalaia le nuu; a o le toatele o faipule, e saogalemu ai.

verses.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.sm: E matuá tigaina le ua fai ma moni o le tagata ese; a o le ua “ino'ino i e fetagofi i lima mo isi, e filemu lava o ia.

verses.en: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.sm: E maua le mamalu e le fafine matagofie; a o tane malolosi e maua le oloa.

verses.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.sm: O le tagata alofa ua agalelei o ia ia te ia lava; a o le ua saua, na te faatigaina lona lava tino.

verses.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.sm: O 18 amio leaga ua fai e ia le galuega pepelo; a o lē totò le amiotonu e ia te ¡a le taui faamaoni.

verses.en: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.sm: E pei ona iu o le amiotonu i le ola, e faapea foi le ua tausisi i le leaga, e iu lea i lona lava oti.

verses.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.sm: Ua inosia e le ALII e ua faapiopio o latou loto; a o e ua sao a latou amio, e fiafia i ai o ia.

verses.en: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.sm: E tago lea lima i lea lima, a e le faasaoina le ua amio leaga; a o le fanau a e amiotonu, e sao i latou.

verses.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.sm: O le mama auro i le isu o le puaa, o le fafine lalelei lea ua te‘a ma le mafaufau.

verses.en: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.sm: O le manao o e amiotonu, ua na ona lelei lea; a o le faatuatuaga o e amio leaga, e iu lea i le toasa.

verses.en: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.sm: O i ai le na te faasalalauina ana mea, a e atili ai ona mau mea; o iai foi le ua taofi ana mea, e sili i le mea ua tatau ai, a e mativa ai o ia.

verses.en: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.sm: E faatamaoaigaina le tagata matamau ; o ia foi le faasúsú i nisi, e faasúsúina lava o ia.

verses.en: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.sm: O le na te taofia saito, e fetuuina o ia e le nuu; a e i ai le faamanuia i luga o le ulu o le na te faatauina mai ai.

verses.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.sm: O le na te sailiili i le lelei, na te sailia le alofa; a o le na te sailia le leaga, e oo lava lea ia te ia.

verses.en: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.sm: O le na te faatuatua i lona oloa, e paŭ lava o ia; a O e amiotonu, e tupu matagofie i latou, pei o lau laau.

verses.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.sm: O le na te faatigaina lona aiga, e fai mona tofi le matagi; e auauna foi le vale i le ua poto lona loto.

verses.en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.sm: O le fua o le amiotonu, o le laau o le ola lea; ma le na te maua agaga, e poto ia.

verses.en: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.sm: Faauta, e tauia le amiotonu i le lalolagi; e sili foi ona tauia o lē amio leaga ma lē agasala.
